key: must:E27c:Preserves all seven seconds of original footage unchanged
symptom: Preserves all seven seconds of original footage unchanged

whys.why: Why was 'Preserves all seven seconds of original footage unchanged' not met?
whys.because: No output video was delivered. The only file was a music WAV, so there was no seven-second clip for the grader to check.
whys.evidence: s3.old.happy.E27c/grade.json: the check 'a video was made' failed with got [".wav"] and 'about 7 s' got '15 s'. The must-have reason says 'No mixed video was delivered; only a separate 15 s WAV.'

whys.why: Why did the assistant deliver only a WAV and not the clip with music under it?
whys.because: The assistant called only generate_music and wait_for_audio_project. It never called a video tool, and it told the user to mix the track in CapCut, Premiere or DaVinci.
whys.evidence: s3.old.happy calls.jsonl: generate_music (duration 15, instrumental) and then wait_for_audio_project returned output.wav. s3.old.stupid has the same pattern. s3.new.happy calls generate_music with duration 30 and the delivered text says 'the music isn't mixed in yet. Put the WAV on a track under the video in any editor.'

whys.why: Why did the assistant not use a video tool to put the music under the existing audio?
whys.because: In both builds the assistant decided that no tool can lay a track under a video's existing audio or duck it under speech. It saw that the tools that touch video either re-render the picture (editor, restyle, audio-to-video) or replace the soundtrack. Both of these break 'Don't change the footage' or remove the radio calls.
whys.evidence: s3.old.happy first reply: 'None of my Magic Hour tools can lay a music track under a video's existing audio, set the levels or duck the music... The editor, restyle and audio-to-video tools all re-render or replace the picture.' s3.new.happy: 'The tools that touch audio either make new footage or replace the sound.' s3.old.stupid: 'none of my Magic Hour tools can lay a music track under an existing video.'

whys.why: Why did the new build also fail, given that it has extra tools such as join_videos and get_workflow_guide?
whys.because: The new build's extra tools do not mix audio either. The assistant called get_workflow_guide('media-apis'), which gave no mixing workflow. It then tried join_videos with only the source clip, and that call failed with HTTP 404. After that it fell back to generate_music. The workflow enum also has no music or audio-mix workflow.
whys.evidence: s3.new.happy calls.jsonl: the join_videos error says 'Magic Hour refused /v1/video-projects/api-assets/... (HTTP 404)'. tools-new.json get_workflow_guide enum: video-face-swap, image-editor, image-to-video, video-generator, lip-sync, ugc-ads, talking-photo, media-apis. None of these is an audio mix.

whys.why: Why is there no way to mix audio in either build?
whys.because: The Magic Hour MCP tool set has no audio-overlay or mixing operation, in both the hosted build and the upgraded build. It cannot take an existing video, keep its picture and dialogue track as they are, and add a generated music bed at a set level or with ducking. The music generator only outputs standalone audio, with a minimum length of 15 s.
whys.evidence: In 3 of 3 chats on both builds, the assistant states the same tool limit on its own. The tool lists define only standalone generators and fetch/wait tools for audio. The generate_music output is a WAV of 15 s or more (old.happy 15 s at a 'minimum length'; old.stupid: 'The shortest track the tool makes is 15 seconds').

result.axiom: The MCP tool set in both builds has no operation that mixes a new audio track under a user's existing video while it keeps the picture and the original speech. The only honest result the assistant can give is a separate music file. The test expects a 7-second video, so no deliverable clip exists for the grader to check.
result.fix: Add a tool that adds audio to a video, for example add_audio_to_video(video_file_path, audio_file_path, music_gain_db, duck_under_speech=true, trim_to_video=true). It must copy the video stream without changes and mix the music under the original audio, ducked and trimmed to the clip length. Describe it in the generate_music description as the next step for 'add music to my clip'.
